text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
maybe my skin's breaking out a little?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I ran out of my go-to care products, so I bought
a temporary replacement, but...
it seems it didn't really agree with me."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, in that case, I have a recommendation!
Even I can use it without worry despite my sensitive skin!
It's an overseas brand, though—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, I want to buy some too!
I'd better arrange for air shipping right away♪

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait! You don't have to go through all that trouble—if you order it online, it'll arrive in no time!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right...!
Then, let me place the order...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I hope it arrives soon~.
Until then, I'll just have to endure this rough skin.
